mapper.sql: -- 현재 할당된 총액을 계산 (NULL인 경우 0으로 처리) COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0) as allocated_amount, -- 잔여액 계산 = 총 보유액 - 현재 할당된 총액 (mp.present_amount - COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0)) as remaining_amount
mapper.select: SELECT mp.member_product_id, mp.item_code as account_number, mp.item_name as account_name, mp.present_amount, , 0 as checked FROM member_product mp -- 각 계좌별로 현재 할당된 총액을 계산하는 서브쿼리 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.member_product_id, SUM(a.amount) as total_allocated FROM action a WHERE a.is_deleted = false AND a.action_type = '예적금' GROUP BY a.member_product_id ) allocated_sum ON mp.member_product_id = allocated_sum.member_product_id WHERE mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp.is_deleted = false -- 모든 계좌 조회 (전부 할당된 계좌도 포함) ORDER BY mp.created_at DESC

SELECT mp.member_product_id, mp.item_code as account_number, mp.item_name as account_name, mp.present_amount, 1 as checked,
FROM member_product mp -- 각 계좌별로 현재 할당된 총액을 계산하는 서브쿼리 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.member_product_id, SUM(a.amount) as total_allocated FROM action a WHERE a.is_deleted = false AND a.action_type = '예적금' GROUP BY a.member_product_id ) allocated_sum ON mp.member_product_id = allocated_sum.member_product_id INNER JOIN action a ON mp.member_product_id = a.member_product_id WHERE mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp.is_deleted = false AND a.object_id = #{objectId} AND a.is_deleted = false AND a.action_type = '예적금' ORDER BY member_product_id DESC

SELECT mp.member_product_id, mp.item_code as account_number, mp.item_name as account_name, mp.present_amount, 0 as checked,
FROM member_product mp -- 각 계좌별로 현재 할당된 총액을 계산하는 서브쿼리 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.member_product_id, SUM(a.amount) as total_allocated FROM action a WHERE a.is_deleted = false AND a.action_type = '예적금' GROUP BY a.member_product_id ) allocated_sum ON mp.member_product_id = allocated_sum.member_product_id WHERE mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp.is_deleted = false -- 잔여액이 0보다 큰 계좌만 조회 (할당 가능한 계좌) AND (mp.present_amount - COALESCE(allocated_sum.total_allocated, 0)) > 0 -- 해당 목적에 할당되지 않은 계좌들만 조회 AND mp.member_product_id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT member_product_id FROM action WHERE object_id = #{objectId} AND member_product_id IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = false AND action_type = '예적금' ) ORDER BY mp.created_at DESC
